evidence_class: designed conditional robustness and interaction stress

commitment_contract.reason_not_varied: The complete commitment domain is already evaluated in the commitment-sensitivity experiment; repeating chi would duplicate a structural main effect.

anchor_contract.historical_anchor: accepted common-authority reference event and parameter register
anchor_contract.severe_reclosure_basis: preregistered structural endpoint, not an empirical forecast
anchor_contract.exploratory_switch_slice_rule: May be added only as an explicitly exploratory mechanism slice if the reclosure experiment identifies a switch; no such slice is included in the preregistered run.

level_rule.basis: Reference-centred half/reference/double levels are dimensionless structural stresses symmetric on the log scale, not confidence intervals.
level_rule.clearance_basis: Two orders below/reference/two orders above the registered numerical tolerance; post-trajectory classification only.

one_factor_screen.operator: set c^E_k=m_E T_D and the matching terminal unit consequence
multiply path normal_model_units by m_Q while preserving released serviceability
multiply berth, yard and gate reference capacities by m_mu
multiply only shared-corridor reference capacity by m_kappa
multiply every nonzero Delta c^res_kr by m_R
multiply every nonzero action-cost coefficient by m_A
set both period and cumulative fractions b in b C^full
set Lambda^R directly in integer weeks
multiply route-wise validation RMSE sigma^W_kr by m_sigma

interactions.basis: long maritime lag combined with the preregistered one-week opening, 0.95 closure intensity and 32-week reclosure

preregistered convex-hazard and low-exit combination; because p=2 is the historical reference, this cell must reproduce the low-exit main-effect cell and is audited as a combined anchor rather than an identified non-additive interaction
nine-gateway end-to-end precontracted network combined with half-reference shared-corridor capacity
sixteen-week readiness lead combined with the preregistered midpoint of the formal gamma_I credibility domain

cell_contract.reference_counting_rule: The common reference is counted once; each simulated factor contributes its two nonreference levels.

policy_design.reference_checkpoint_rule: Use accepted 5.2.2 checkpoints as the historical-anchor matched policies.
policy_design.screening_rule: Dimension-compatible one-factor cells use frozen deployment policies; maritime-lag and readiness-lead cells use Passive, Reactive and online MPC because their feature dimension changes.
policy_design.matched_retraining_rule: Only the long-lag severe-reclosure anchor receives new matched BC and full constrained-SAC training; the nine-gateway interaction uses the frozen size-specific 5.3.3 checkpoint and the lead-16 interaction excludes incompatible learned checkpoints.
policy_design.network_checkpoint_rule: The nine-gateway checkpoint is size-matched but frozen before the low-corridor perturbation.

path_design.selection_rule: Select the largest preregistered count supported by training plus validation-path gate timing and the remaining eight-hour budget; outcomes never select N.
path_design.learning_seed_rule: Average the three learning seeds within each physical path before paired summaries.

inference.multiplicity: Holm-adjusted paired p-values and simultaneous t intervals within each declared family.
inference.regret_rule: Path-paired regret is defined only over the policy family actually evaluated in each cell.
inference.stability_rule: Policy identity is conditional on the declared physical-path ensemble and evaluated controller family; missing policies are never imputed.
